result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, but there is one state inconsistency: the 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected, yet the feed below is unfiltered and the Home tab still shows the default mixed content (poké, burgers, ramen). No other visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are expected scroll behaviour.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip appears in the selected state (dark filled background, white text), but the content below is not filtered: 'Fastest near you' shows Green Bowl Poké and Smash Bros Burgers, and 'Popular right now' leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar. The selected chip does not match the displayed content, so either the wrong chip is highlighted (should be 'All') or the filter was not applied.
issues.suggestion: Sync the chip selection state with the feed. If no filter is active, highlight 'All'; if Pizza is selected, filter the lists to show only pizza restaurants.
